architecture: Equal-weight average of the class probabilities of the logistic-regression baseline and the GRU temporal model (weight chosen on signer-grouped validation folds)

gru.architecture: Temporal model: per-frame linear embedding (96) -> bidirectional GRU (96 per direction) -> mean+max pooling + global motion features -> linear softmax; AdamW, class-weighted loss, early stopping on a held-out split of training samples (PyTorch, CPU)

ensemble.architecture: Equal-weight average of the class probabilities of the logistic-regression baseline and the GRU temporal model (weight chosen on signer-grouped validation folds)
